## 🚀 How to Get Started

1. Install Node.js 18+ from https://nodejs.org
2. Open PowerShell in project directory
3. Run: npm install
4. Run: npm run dev
5. Open: http://localhost:3000

See QUICKSTART.md for 5-minute setup or SETUP_GUIDE.md for detailed instructions.
